name: John O'Sullivan
bio: John O'Sullivan was Medora's barber; in May 1884 he bought a lot, and by July he had finished a barber shop and bath rooms next to John Warn's, offering baths for 50 cents. In winter 1884–85 he fixed up the shop, which he planned to call "The Gem," and when Father Martin's petition brought books to town in January 1885 the library opened at his shop with him in charge. He also shot in the Bad Lands Gun Club matches early in 1885. In June 1885 he moved west to open a barber shop at Anaconda and then settled in Butte City, and his Medora lot and house were put up for sale.
